Get up where you last saved or reached a checkpoint, or load another save.
The Tarnish is spreading through Lanthorne. It takes hold of its people and fills them with dark magic.
Wren Hale, the Silverer, is the only one who can burn the Tarnish out of Lanthorne.
The Tarnish reached {0} of {1}. Its hold on Lanthorne is complete.
Lanthorne is about to fall. Burn out the Tarnish.
If the Tarnish reaches the cap, Lanthorne falls.
Anything since your last save is lost. You'll be back where this save was made.
The autosave is replaced by the new run. Your quick save and Slots 1-3 are kept.
The save already in this slot is replaced by where you are now.
The autosave follows you: it saves at every checkpoint. Quick load: F9.
No quick save yet (F5, or hold Start)
Saving also sets your checkpoint: if you fall, you get up here. Quick save: F5, or hold Start.
High holds 60 fps on most mid-range PCs. Epic adds ray-traced lighting.
High holds 60 fps on most mid-range PCs. Epic adds ray-traced lighting. (In the editor, resolution and window mode are left alone.)
Voice chat sends what you say to Google to generate replies. It stays off unless you add your own Google API key.
Hold Right Mouse to aim your magic. A reticle shows where the spell will land.
Hold LT to aim your magic. A reticle shows where the spell will land.
Left Mouse or Q casts the selected spell. Tab switches spells, 1-4 picks one.
RT casts the selected spell (hold to repeat). RB / LB switch spells.
Press K to open Spell Crafting and build your own spells. Keys 5-8 pick a crafted spell.
Press View to open Spell Crafting and build your own spells. D-pad Up picks a crafted spell.
Mirror shards are rare. Each one is worth finding.
You can step through now. Hold X to step up into the next side, Z to step down. It takes a mirror shard and most of your magic.
You can step through now. Hold Y to step up into the next side, R3 to step down. It takes a mirror shard and most of your magic.
The Final Spell burned the Tarnish out of its last face. The tarnished wake, and Lanthorne is itself again.
